fact_text: Pakistan's current account is in surplus as of 19 Jan 2024, as it was in June 2021, and the analyst reads this as a supply-side strength.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: Monthly exports of about 3 billion dollars, as the analyst puts it, would add up to roughly 36 billion dollars a year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: Federal Board of Revenue collections are running at about 1 trillion rupees a month as of 19 Jan 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: The analyst sees a strong and positive outlook for the KSE-100 for 2024, based on supply-side indicators such as the current account and tax collection.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: About 700 million dollars from the IMF has already been received by Pakistan, with a further programme being discussed.

fact_text: The analyst expects the budget to be presented in May or June 2024, after the elections, which he says makes the near-term outlook look stable.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: The analyst expects second-quarter earnings for cement companies, the quarter ended 31 Dec 2023, to beat first-quarter earnings, with Fauji Cement, Maple Leaf and DG Khan cited as examples.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: The Pak Suzuki Motor share buyback dispute was resolved and the company agreed, though the analyst said the position of the largest shareholders still needs to be watched.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: The cement bag price is rising in Punjab, and the analyst says no one is stopping it, which helps cement margins even though it adds to inflation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: Raw coal prices, a major cement input, have fallen sharply, which widens cement makers' margins.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: With no snowfall reported in the hill areas of KP and Punjab as of 19 Jan 2024, construction activity should lift cement dispatches, though demand is not yet at peak levels.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: The State Bank benchmark policy rate stood at about 22 percent on 19 Jan 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX Outlook 2024 | Bullish Market | Pakistan Stock Market Update' (YouTube, 2024-01-19)

fact_text: The analyst says inflation has not yet come down enough to justify any cut in the policy rate, so lower interest rates are not yet in view.
